threshold_provenance.calibrated_on: FD002 held-out test set, 209 engines at final observed cycle, true RUL from RUL_FD002.txt
threshold_provenance.criterion: lowest threshold achieving recall >= 0.80, then best precision
threshold_provenance.rationale: the shipped thresholds were tuned far too high: at 0.97 the 10-cycle horizon caught 0 of 22 real imminent failures despite AUC 0.887, i.e. the ranking was good but the cut was unusable
threshold_provenance.scope: FD002 only -- FD001/FD003/FD004 are unchanged because no held-out ground truth was scored for them in this calibration
